frozen.disclosure: SECOND MEASUREMENT (paid evaluation, public) of Microsoft-Decision-1 after a weights update reported by Microsoft. ITEMS: n = 1,493 of the draw's 1,500 items (1,193 sealed + 300 public): 7 sealed items are excluded because this provider had seen them in an earlier evaluation, so every score, the speed and the cost are computed on those 1,493 items. DRAW: measured on the 27 Oct 2026 regular draw (fresh sealed items; not yet equated to the reference scale, so its numbers are shown as published, offset 0).
